optimizedDescription.value: CLI `specs optimizations` reads/mutates lock-owned optimized fields via Core, with strict input, output, and error contracts.

optimizedContext.value:
# cli:spec-optimizations

## Rules
- Commands: `specs optimizations get <spec-id> [--field optimizedDescription|optimizedContext]`; `set <spec-id> [--input <json-file|-> | --optimized-description <text> [--optimized-context <text>]]`; `clear <spec-id> [--field optimizedDescription|optimizedContext... | --optimized-description] [--optimized-context]`. Every leaf accepts `--format text|json|toon` (default `text`) and `.allowExcessArguments(false)`.
- `get`: one `Kernel.specs.getPersistedOptimizations(specId, field?)`; output values + per-field freshness/reasons and aggregate freshness. Text marks `STALE` + `artifact-added|artifact-removed|artifact-changed|schema-changed`; no state = not initialized; absent requested field = missing, not error.
- `set`: exactly one input form; `--input` JSON object only allowed keys `optimizedDescription|optimizedContext`, non-empty string values; direct options map atomically. Reject mixed/missing input, malformed/empty/invalid JSON before Core. One `Kernel.specs.updatePersistedOptimizations({set})`; print result.
- `clear`: exactly one selection form: repeated `--field` or direct flags; reject mixed/missing before Core. One `Kernel.specs.updatePersistedOptimizations({clear})`; print result, possibly empty.
- Handlers never hash artifacts, derive freshness/baselines, or write persisted state; each operation maps parsed flags to one Kernel call.
- Errors: `SpecNotFoundError`, invalid input JSON (`error: invalid JSON: <message>` before Core), `ArtifactConflictError` (retry), `ReadOnlyWorkspaceError` → exit 1.

## Constraints
- Never access `spec-lock.json` directly; only Kernel optimization APIs.
- Never invoke LLM or decide gate; caller owns `llmOptimizedContext`.
- `specs optimizations set` is sole optimized-value persist route; no metadata-writer equivalent.
